name: Bananas are berries (strawberries aren't)

hook_variants.template: Bananas are berries. Strawberries are not. The food pyramid lied.
Which one is actually a berry: banana or strawberry?
Botanists would call your fruit salad a scam.

sections.text: In botany, a berry is a fruit grown from one flower with one ovary.
By that rule, bananas and tomatoes count. Strawberries don't.
sections.title: the real berries

sections.text: A strawberry is an 'aggregate fruit'. The dots are the actual fruits.
sections.title: the twist

sections.text: Watermelon, pumpkin, and even chili peppers are berries too.
sections.subtitle: surprise berries: banana, tomato, watermelon, pumpkin

sections.text: So next time, you can call a tomato a berry and be technically right.
Follow for more facts that make you look smart at dinner.

facts.claim: In botanical terms, a berry is a fleshy fruit from a single ovary of a single flower
Bananas, tomatoes, watermelons and pumpkins are botanically berries
The strawberry is an aggregate fruit, not a true berry

titles: The fruit classification that breaks your brain
You've been wrong about strawberries your whole life
